name: Interdisciplinary Biological Sciences (IBiS) PhD Program
summary: Interdisciplinary biological sciences doctoral training with three first-year laboratory rotations.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application for full financial support

english.toefl: 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026; 90 before January 21, 2026
english.note: MET 61. English-instructed accredited undergraduate or graduate degree exempts TOEFL. Official scores no more than two years old at intended matriculation.

applicationFee.note: Graduate School waivers require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and qualifying eligibility; limited and first come, first served. No additional program waivers.

documents: Academic statement (500–1000 words), including faculty interests
Scanned official transcript from each postsecondary institution
Research statement (1–2 pages), uploaded as Supplemental Document 1

funding.note: December 1 application deadline is for consideration for full financial support: tuition, stipend and health insurance. The admissions page does not explicitly guarantee funding for every admitted student.

timeline.interviews: Selected applicants interview in late January and early February; top applicants visit in March.
timeline.decisions: Offers soon after interviews; applicants without an interview receive a decision by April 15.
